abilities.critical_failure: The character takes 4d10+22 piercing damage from the spikes plus 2d6 bleeddamage. While the character is taking this bleed damage, they are also sickened 2 from the pain.
abilities.critical_success: The character avoids all of the spikes and takes no additional damage.
abilities.effect: The triggering creature falls and rolls through several spikes as it slides to the bottom. This inflicts 5 bludgeoning damage from the fall itself down the steep slope (the falling PC can't attempt to Grab an Edge due to the lack of defined edges to the pit's walls), but the falling PC must also attempt a DC 26 Reflex save.
abilities.failure: The character takes 4d10+22 piercing damage from the spikes.
abilities.name: Spiked Pitall
abilities.success: The character takes 2d10+11 piercing damage from the spikes.
abilities.trigger: A creature walks onto one of the pits

hazard.description: A 20-foot deep, funnel-shaped pit with dozens of wooden spikes lining its walls.
hazard.disable: Yanking the cloth away is a simple way to expose the danger to allow someone to merely avoid it by walking around its edges, but it cannot be quickly disabled.
hazard.name: Camouflaged Spiked Pit
hazard.reset: Creatures can still fall into the trap once it has been exposed, but the camouflaged cover must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
